name: Steelchop
description: Open the forms with a straight chop from a high azure guard and a pulse of qi in the edge.

name: Curvespine Troth
description: Hold the first guard of the forms with the blade slanted upward across the body.

name: Mighty Rearedge
description: Take the measured pace of the forms with the blade held ready at the shoulder.

name: Illustrious Chopbelly
description: Hew in the manner of the forms with qi renewed at the instant of contact.

name: Millstone Scrape
description: Hook the foe's blade with the curve in the school's binding form and hold it aside.

name: Dishguard Pledge
description: Break the foe's gathering of qi with a timed beat in the manner of the forms.

name: Inferno Bellyblade
description: Cleave through a guard in the school's full form with the body and qi in one line.

name: Resonant Knucklebar
description: Chain the guard and the snare and the cleave of the forms in order as one qi-led sequence.

name: Whisk Banner
description: Pierce a guard at its thinnest point with the tip and a thread of qi in the school's elite form.

name: Triumphant Swathe
description: Drop from a high guard in one arc as the school teaches and spend qi as the cut requires.

name: Matchless Slice
description: Chop where two lines of attack meet like two rivers joining and put the weight through the edge.

name: Stately Spineback
description: Stand with the blade as a bank against the push of a blow and let it flow past.

name: Squall Tipbend
description: Walk with a heavy even step through the foe's attack like one crossing a silted bank.

name: Inferno Dragcut
description: Hew at the point where the foe's blade and one's own cross with qi flowing along both.

name: Masterful Brush
description: Draw the foe's blade into a slow turning backwater of qi where it loses its drive.

name: Venombevel
description: Beat the foe's blade round in a spiral and tear its qi from the pattern of its technique.

name: Seasondish
description: Press the foe with a steady rising weight of cuts like a river swelling over its banks.

name: Magmascrape
description: Sweep the blade out in a fan of cuts like channels of a delta that reach every foe nearby.

name: Squall Flatside
description: Take a blow along one current and return it along the other as a sharp counter cut.

name: Sigil Dishguard
description: Cut across the foe's meridians with a flood of qi that dams their flow in the school's elite form.

name: Inferno Scrape
description: Close two currents of cut and qi on the foe as the school teaches and bind it between them.

name: Valiant Ringpommel
description: Chop down from a high raised blade with the whole body dropping behind the stroke.

name: Prism Ringpommel
description: Hold a guard that rides the foe's push like a hawk riding a rising wind.

name: Squall Rearedge
description: Climb a rising step onto higher ground and keep the blade held above the foe.

name: Thunderclap Flatside
description: Draw the belly across the foe in a long gliding slice like the beat of a wing.

name: Bedrock Whisk
description: Hew from a skyward leap with qi gathered at the top of the rise.

name: Titan Chopbelly
description: Catch the foe's wrist with the curve like a hawk's grip and pull it wide.

name: Subjugating Knucklebar
description: Beat the foe's blade crosswise like the cross beat of two wings and break its rhythm of qi.

name: Bedrock Slice
description: Hover above the foe with the blade poised and hold it down by the threat of the stoop.

name: Dishtriumph
description: Gather qi at the top of a long rise and stoop in a cleave that falls with its whole weight.

name: Squall Bellyblade
description: Sweep a blow aside with the flat like a pinion and return a rising cut.

name: Skyborne Spineback
description: Flash across the gap in a stoop and pierce the foe's guard at a single point in the school's elite form.

name: Gallant Dragcut Decree
description: Rise to the high azure and fall upon the foe in the school's stoop with qi spent as the strike demands.

name: Scrapeedict
description: Chop from the first court with the second court held ready to answer.

name: Undaunted Ringpommel
description: Hold the formal posture of the court with the blade upright before the body.

name: Bevelsolace
description: Walk the measured court pace toward the foe with the blade upright and still.

name: Illustrious Brush
description: Hew a single decided stroke that ends the exchange with qi bearing down through the edge.

name: Swathe Reliquary
description: Hook the foe's blade and hold it before the court as evidence of the exchange.

name: Authoritative Dishguard
description: Beat the foe's blade so firmly that its technique falls silent mid-motion.

name: Thunderclap Knucklebar
description: Cleave with the full weight of the court's judgment and the field of qi behind the edge.

name: Season Chopbelly
description: Chain a posture and a bind and a verdict as one paired passage of the court.

name: Dishvow
description: Meet an advanced technique in the paired court and cancel its pattern in the school's elite form.

name: Steel Whisk
description: Pass judgment on a foe's technique in the school's form and spend qi as the verdict requires.

name: Haemal Swathe
description: Open the descents with a chop that begins at the top of a leap and ends at the foe.

name: Prismchop
description: Fold the blade and arm into the guard that follows each descent.

name: Squall Dragcut
description: Take the gliding approach that sets up the next descent from the proper height.

name: Haemalwhisk
description: Draw a long raking slice at the foot of the descent with qi on the belly.

name: Matchless Spineback
description: Hew in the manner of the third descent with qi gathered from the whole body.

name: Millstone Slice
description: Hook and hold the foe's blade in the manner of the fourth descent.

name: Seasonswathe
description: Press the foe from above in the manner of the fifth descent and hold it low.

name: Venom Flatside
description: Beat the foe's blade with the force of the sixth descent and scatter its qi.

name: Quenched Rearedge
description: Gather qi in the field and cleave downward from the height of the descent.

name: Tempestuous Bellyblade
description: Sweep the blade round at the foot of the descent and cut every foe nearby.

name: Radiance Scrape
description: Flash down upon the foe from height and pierce its guard in the school's elite form.

name: Slicecrown
description: Perform the seventh and highest descent of the school and spend qi as the fall requires.

name: Gallant Bellyblade
description: Chop with the first reach of the edge beyond the body in the school's opening form.

name: Inviolate Spineback
description: Hold a guard with a faint aura of qi spread about the blade.

name: Bedrock Tipbend
description: Step lightly with the glow of the Core steadying the body and the blade.

name: Vigor Rearedge
description: Hew with qi drawn from the Core straight into the edge.

name: Sigil Scrape
description: Wind the aura round the foe's blade with a turn of the edge and hold it.

name: Entropy Brush
description: Beat with a pulse of Core qi that jars the foe's technique apart.

name: Millstone Whisk
description: Press the foe with the weight of the aura and keep its blade from rising.

name: Steel Chopbelly
description: Gather Core qi in the blade and cleave with the full reach of the aura.

name: Colossal Tipbend
description: Sweep the aura round the body to throw back every foe within its reach.

name: Volition Ringpommel
description: Cut with Core qi laid on the edge to close the foe's meridians for a time in the school's elite form.

name: Prism Brush
description: Carry the edge beyond the body by the light of the Core as the school teaches and spend qi as the reach requires.

name: Steelswathe
description: Chop on a vowed breath drawn deep with the edge falling as the breath is released.

name: Steel Tipbend
description: Stand in the sworn guard that gives no ground to the foe's push.

name: Squallbevel
description: Pace forward at the speed of a steady wind with the blade held ready.

name: Haemal Flatside
description: Hew with a steady rushing pull of qi that follows the line of the stroke.

name: Thunderous Dragcut
description: Hook the foe's blade with a gust-like pull and drag it from its line.

name: Imperious Swathe
description: Beat the foe's blade in quick buffeting blows that unsettle its qi.

name: Season Tipbend
description: Press the foe with unbroken gusting cuts that keep its blade from rising.

name: Swathebanner
description: Gather qi on a held breath and cleave with the whole force of the wind.

name: Solar Knucklebar
description: Sweep the blade round in a wide wind-driven arc that cuts every foe in reach.

name: Statute Dishguard
description: Cut with a gust of qi that stops the flow in the foe's channels for a time in the school's elite form.

name: Gallant Thunderclap Whisk
description: Speak the school's vow and cut upon it with qi spent as the oath requires.

name: Valiant Slice
description: Chop from a rooted stance as an oath is rooted in the stone of the plateau.

name: Choppledge
description: Hold the blade steady as an oath stone against the push of the foe's attack.

name: Dunescrape
description: March toward the foe in the slow pace of one who has sworn to arrive.

name: Haemalbrush
description: Hew with the settled weight of a sworn stone and qi pressed through the edge.

name: Dragcut Covenant
description: Hook the foe's blade and hold it against the oath until it yields.

name: Venombrush
description: Beat the foe's blade like a stone struck on stone and break its qi apart.

name: Vaunted Spineback
description: Cleave straight down with the settled weight of a sworn stone.

name: Scrapebanner
description: Chain a march and a bind and a cleave as one sworn passage across the plateau.

name: Vacuum Chopbelly
description: Meet an advanced technique with the sworn guard and cancel its pattern in the school's elite form.

name: Peerless Steel Flatside
description: Hold the oath to the edge of the plateau as the school teaches and spend qi as the oath requires.

name: Intrepid Knucklebar
description: Chop along the bearing taken from the stars and hold the line to the end of the stroke.

name: Prismdish
description: Hold the blade as steady as a fixed star against any push.

name: Slicegrace
description: Step along a night heading toward the foe without wavering from the bearing.

name: Squallwhisk
description: Draw a slice along a line drawn from star to star with qi even on the belly.

name: Swathe Edict
description: Hew along the held bearing with qi gathered from the steadiness of the stance.

name: Scrapevow
description: Hook the foe's blade onto the heading and hold it from its own line.

name: Vaunted Scrape
description: Press the foe patiently like a long night with unhurried cuts along the bearing.

name: Entropy Bellyblade
description: Beat the foe's blade with a sudden fall of force and scatter its qi.

name: Inferno Ringpommel
description: Gather qi on the bearing and cleave along it as if breaking the sky.

name: Inferno Rearedge
description: Sweep the blade round through a ring of cuts that mark out a constellation about the body.

name: Thunderclap Dishguard
description: Flash along the bearing to the foe and cut at its end in the school's elite form.

name: Inferno Spineback
description: Hold the bearing through every exchange as the school teaches and spend qi as the line requires.

name: Haemal Slice
description: Chop in the open field with a stance that needs no cover at flank or back.

name: Curvespine Vow
description: Hold a guard that leaves the flank open but covers the line of the cut.

name: Windborne Whisk
description: Rove across open land in long easy steps and never settle in one place.

name: Squall Ringpommel
description: Hew from a roving stride with qi gathered along the whole run of the body.

name: Curvespine Reliquary
description: Hook the foe's blade on the move and drag it wide of the body.

name: Commanding Brush
description: Beat the foe's blade with a wide-armed stroke that scatters its qi.

name: Curvespine Decree
description: Press the foe across open land with cuts that leave it no cover to turn to.

name: Beveledict
description: Gather qi in a wide stance and cleave across the foe in a single open stroke.

name: Sliceverdict
description: Sweep the sabre in a wide ring that cuts every foe within the reach of the stride.

name: Slicevow
description: Cut in the open field and close the foe's meridians for a time in the school's elite form.

name: Illustrious Thunderclap Slice
description: Cut in the open as the school teaches with no cover sought and qi spent as the stroke requires.

name: Vigorbevel
description: Chop with the blade held steady against the push of a strong wind.

name: Prismbevel
description: Hold the blade slanted across the wind so cuts are shed like gusts.

name: Bedrock Bellyblade
description: Run with the wind at the back and cut the distance to the foe at once.

name: Haemalbevel
description: Draw a slice that parts the foe's guard like wind tearing a cloud.

name: Chopbanner
description: Hew along a gale's bearing with qi carried on the push of the wind.

name: Sigil Flatside
description: Catch the foe's blade like a sail catching wind and haul it out of line.

name: Millstone Swathe
description: Press the foe with unbroken gale cuts along a held bearing.

name: Thunderclap Rearedge
description: Beat the foe's blade so hard that its qi splits like a cloud before the wind.

name: Dauntless Curvespine
description: Gather the whole gale in the field and cleave through the foe's guard.

name: Knucklebar Crown
description: Sweep the blade in a ring of gale that cuts every foe near the wielder.

name: Season Dragcut
description: Flash across open ground on the wind and cut in the school's elite form.

name: Triumphant Quenched Chopbelly
description: Take the seventh and highest bearing of the school and spend qi as the gale requires.

name: Inferno Brush
description: Chop with the edge reaching a little beyond the steel in the school's opening form.

name: Unwavering Tipbend
description: Hold a guard steadied by the glow of the Core and rooted like the plateau.

name: Dunechop
description: Step toward the far horizon and the foe on it in long Core-lit strides.

name: Storied Curvespine
description: Hew with a gale of Core qi streaming straight down the blade.

name: Millstone Dishguard
description: Hook the foe's blade and draw it out along the horizon line.

name: Authoritative Scrape
description: Beat with a gust of Core qi that jars the foe's technique apart.

name: Scrapecrown
description: Gather Core qi in the blade and cleave with the reach of the far plateau.

name: Famed Scrape
description: Sweep a ring of Core gale round the body and cut every foe within it.

name: Commanding Dragcut
description: Cut with Core qi laid on the edge to close the foe's meridians for a time in the school's elite form.

name: Magnificent Dishguard Triumph
description: Carry the edge beyond the plateau by the light of the Core as the school teaches and spend qi as the reach requires.
